text: Assalam o alaikum, sorry to mesage so late. My grandson is 4 months old, I am looking after him tonite and his temprature is 38.1. Ya Allah I am so worried, his mama is away. He has some itchy insect bites on his legs, little red bumps, he keeps rubbing them. I think his throat is sore, he makes a face when he swallows, but he is still drinking his milk properly, feeding normal like always, poori bottle khatam ki. No fits, no shaking or jerking, nothing like that, I have been watching him the whole time. But bachay itnay chotay hain, I dont know what to do. Kya main usay doctor ke paas le kar jaoon tonight or can I wait for morning?
